text: Water discharge: the temperature rise across the condenser shall not exceed 7 K in steady-state operation in all ambient conditions (TQ-041), the temperature excess at 100 m from the diffuser 3 K and the residual oxidant at the end of the outfall pipe 0.1 mg/l, sampled at the outfall seal pit without credit for mixing (DP-CASE-0015 to DP-CASE-0017, TQ-041); the electro-chlorination dosing shall follow DEC-EPCE-0015; process and sanitary effluents shall be treated to the sea-discharge limits of the Water Pollution Control Regulation before discharge to the CW outfall; the SWRO brine is returned only while a CW pump runs (DEC-EPCE-0015), so that the salinity excess at 50 m from the diffuser stays within DP-EPCE-0012.
